violation_type.title: Equipment Prohibited for Younger Than 5 Yrs -Free Standing Arch Climbers (26 TAC §747.4405(a)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Equipment Prohibited for Younger Than 5 Yrs -Free Standing Arch Climbers
violation_type.typical_finding: The home had a free standing arch climber in the outdoor space. This was corrected at inspection when the provider removed the free standing arch climber during the inspection.
